description: Wave 4 (Deep-Reader unification), STRICT ENRICHMENT precedent (Wave 3): the conversation layer's OWN pronoun/anaphora path is `comp_anaphor` -> `resolve_anaphor_to_current_topic` (seeds/conversation_topic_tracking.json), which resolves a bare pronoun/possessive ONLY against the tracked `current_topic` and only ABSTAINS (mints nothing) when there is no tracked topic. Meanwhile every daemon turn's shadow read (Wave 2, `_shadow_read_turn`) runs the REAL deep-reader coref chain (SmMention -refers_to-> SmEntity, resonant across turns) and, when it resolved a pronoun this turn, records the winner mechanically as `shadow_referent` on the Message (substrate/world_adapter.py -- a plain readback, no decision). `resolve_pronoun_from_shadow` is the DECISION: it fires ONLY in the routed-nowhere case (nothing else has claimed the turn: not the explicit topic route, not the elliptical shift, and not -- explicitly excluded, never a race -- the old anaphor-to-current-topic route when THAT route's own preconditions hold), and ONLY when the shadow referent is SAFE to trust: it is the armed deictic-centre speaker/addressee (a graph-resident `DeicticCentre` node) OR its name matches a held `Concept` -- anything else stays unresolved (honest; no forced bind). On a match it mints the SAME `Goal{kind:answer_topic}` the conversation layer's own routes mint, so the EXISTING topic-answer machinery (reply_topic_from_held_answer / _answer_topic_reply / answer_about) renders it -- no new reply machinery. `note_pronoun_referent_divergence` is a pure DATUM (never consulted by any routing rule, exactly like `speech_act_divergence`, Wave 3): when the OLD anaphor-to-topic route's own preconditions held (comp_anaphor + a tracked current_topic) and its target NAME differs from the shadow referent, this records the disagreement for a future retirement decision -- it never changes the turn's reply (the old route already claimed the turn in that case; this rule doesn't touch `comprehended`). The conversation reference path is NOT retired this wave.

rules.name: resolve_pronoun_from_shadow
rules.comment: ROUTED-NOWHERE ONLY: fires when nothing else claimed the turn (comprehended unset) AND none of the sibling routes' own preconditions hold (explicit exclusion, never a fixpoint race -- the SAME discipline Wave 3's shadow-focus topic fill used) AND the shadow referent is SAFE (armed deictic speaker/addressee, or name-matches a held Concept).

rules.name: note_pronoun_referent_divergence
rules.comment: DATUM ONLY (never consulted by any routing rule -- the speech_act_divergence precedent): the old anaphor-to-topic route's own preconditions held (comp_anaphor + a tracked current_topic) and its target differs from the shadow referent. Independent idempotence guard (does not touch `comprehended` -- this rule never claims the turn).
